verdict.rationale: Asana is a work-management product, so sprint planning is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents sprints, backlogs, iterations, story points, velocity or burndown. Generic task/project creation, boards and Jira/GitHub sync are adjacent features and earn no credit for agile sprint planning.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can plan and manage sprints for agile software development
